name: Hasumi Tatsuya
source:
Classmate of the protagonist.
At first look he seems like a stylish guy in touch with today's trends.
However he's overflowing with baseless self-confidence that is typical of puberty.
He looks at his surroundings with somewhat cold eyes.

Only appears in the PSP version.
